abstract: In traditional recommender systems (RSs), textual information typically serves as auxiliary signals for representation learning. In contrast, in LLM-based RSs, textual information becomes the primary medium for recommendation generation through semantic understanding and reasoning. This shift fundamentally changes the attack surface, making promotion-driven manipulations more feasible, effective, and harder to detect. However, effectively detecting such attacks remains largely unexplored. To fill this gap, we present the first systematic study on detecting promotion-driven attacks against LLM-based RSs, aiming to safeguard next-generation recommendation platforms. Specifically, we propose GuardAgent, a novel LLM-powered agentic detection framework that operates through a loop of Perception, Action, Reflection and Memory. In contrast to conventional LLM-based detectors that function in a static, one-off, and opaque fashion, GuardAgent continually learns and self-evolves to adapt to unseen threat patterns while generating explainable reasoning traces and outcomes. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate that GuardAgent achieves state-of-the-art generalization performance, laying the foundation for robust and trustworthy recommendation in practical settings. business_implications_zh: 对采用LLM推荐系统的平台而言，推广驱动文本操纵是需纳入风控与内容治理的专门风险。
可解释的推理轨迹与检测结果有助于审核、申诉和合规审计，但实际落地仍需人工复核与治理流程配合。
持续学习与自我演化思路适合应对不断变化的推广操纵模式，但上线前需评估稳定性、成本与误报影响。
该工作目前仅提供摘要级证据，业务部署前应要求完整实验报告和真实业务场景验证。
contributions_zh: 提出首个针对LLM-based推荐系统中推广驱动攻击检测的系统性研究。
提出GuardAgent，一个由LLM驱动的智能体检测框架，围绕Perception、Action、Reflection和Memory循环运行。
区别于静态、一次性且不透明的传统LLM检测器，GuardAgent能够持续学习与自我演化，以适应未见威胁模式，并生成可解释的推理轨迹和结果。
在真实世界数据集上的实验表明，GuardAgent取得state-of-the-art泛化性能。

deep_reading.method_zh: GuardAgent采用LLM驱动的智能体式检测框架，通过Perception、Action、Reflection和Memory构成的循环进行检测，并强调持续学习、自我演化以及可解释推理轨迹与结果输出。
deep_reading.problem_zh: 在LLM-based推荐系统中，文本信息从辅助信号变成推荐生成的主要媒介，这改变了攻击面，使推广驱动的操纵更可行、更有效且更难检测；但如何有效检测此类攻击仍缺乏系统研究。

summary_zh: 该论文提出GuardAgent，用具备感知—行动—反思—记忆循环的LLM智能体检测LLM推荐系统中的推广型对抗攻击，并强调可解释与自适应。
title: GuardAgent: A Memory-Augmented Agentic Framework for Adaptive Detection of Adversarial Promotions in LLM-Based Recommendation
